command:
SELECT s.title, p.sales_30d, s.arm
FROM app.users u, shop.search(u.identifier, u.traits, 'wireless headphones', 5) WITH ORDINALITY s
JOIN shop.products p ON p.id = s.product_id
WHERE u.identifier = 'user-42' ORDER BY s.ordinality;
